scope: Numerical representation and threshold method-fit; no RTL simulation, trained-model approximation study, hardware or literature result

current_mechanism.state: Full signed-int11 U remains in the original integer unit. It is not divided or multiplied during format adaptation.
current_mechanism.selection: Three signed7 membranes if delta<=25 and all U are within[-64,63]; otherwise three signed6 membranes if all U are within[-32,31]; otherwise two full-range membranes.
current_mechanism.guard: Safety is checked before issue. It does not deliberately overflow a packed lane and then recover an unknown carry.
current_mechanism.fallback: The same original int11 membranes use the wide two-lane arithmetic; there is no persistent wider state migration.

experiments.name: Generic exact mantissa plus residue leakage identity
experiments.distinction: This experiment proves generic algebra. Current DSP RTL supports delta0..31 only.
experiments.fit: Exact if all residue/carry bits and their correction are retained; overhead and lane-safety still need hardware measurement.

experiments.name: Exact signed narrow payload plus high spill
experiments.fit: An exact high/low spill can preserve U, but spill bandwidth/storage/control is added work. It is not a new novelty claim by itself.

experiments.name: Discarding one mantissa residue bit
experiments.fit: Fails current exact-output contract whenever discarded bits matter; retaining residue repairs arithmetic.

experiments.name: Leakage rounding does not commute with exact state scaling
experiments.fit: Even when U is exactly divisible by2, ordinary integer leakage in the half unit is not generally the same update. Residue/correction or aligned rounding conditions are required.

experiments.name: Stochastic divide2 is unbiased but spikes differ
experiments.fit: Possible approximate SNN direction with separate training/accuracy/statistical evaluation; not exact recovery or a drop-in exact-output optimization.

experiments.name: Constant times1.5
experiments.exact_fractional_encoding: Keep numerator3U=(U<<1)+U with one fractional bit.
experiments.fit: Constant1.5 does not inherently require a general real multiplier. Discarding the half bit or changing state units without matching every update/threshold/reset can change SNN behavior.

strongest_exact_integration: Use actual U to choose a proved-safe packed format; retain full integer state and exact high/low or spill correction. Test the same correction machinery in fixed DSP and LUT baselines. A persistent exponent with residue is a representation option, not a free hardware gain.
novelty_limits: This screen does not read or verify the mentor's guard-bit paper. Root literature review must identify its precise contract and compare that mechanism.
Exact spill, guard bits, split products, mantissa/exponent and stochastic rounding are broad established concepts. A literal first-ever claim is unsupported here.
The local LUT triple and fixed hybrid are matched primitive baselines, not reproduced FireFly accelerators.
limitations: No FPGA synthesis, routing, occupancy, speed, power or accelerator measurement.
No general SNN classification-loss prediction follows from the numerical threshold counterexamples.
Exponent/residue spills may simply relocate reconstruction cost to the consumer; fair end-to-end cost is required.
